==Usage==
To alter the template to apply to an [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]] that was considered [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity, include the "canon" parameter with any value. Example: <nowiki>{{Easteregg|canon=1}}</nowiki>.
